description: This PHP class implements the DataTransformerInterface to transform between Document objects and other representations within a Symfony form context, specifically handling conversion of Document instances and File instances.

classes.name: ModelContractDocumentTransformer
classes.description: A data transformer for converting Document objects and files within form processing.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Returns the input document without modification.

methods.name: reverseTransform
methods.description: Converts array or File input into a Document object, creating new Document instances as needed.
